entries.name: Small stone
entries.description: Small stone that can be thrown up or unsettle two-wheelers.

entries.name: Medium stone
entries.description: Stone large enough to damage tyres or underbody.

entries.name: Large stone
entries.description: Stone that blocks a wheel path.

entries.name: Boulder
entries.description: Boulder obstructing a lane.

entries.name: Falling rock
entries.description: Rock actively falling or recently fallen from a slope.

entries.name: Gravel
entries.description: Loose aggregate on the surface reducing grip.

entries.name: Sand
entries.description: Sand spread or heaped on the carriageway.

entries.name: Soil pile
entries.description: Heap of soil dumped on the road.

entries.name: Mud pile
entries.description: Wet mud heap or slide deposit.

entries.name: Fallen tree
entries.description: Tree lying across one or more lanes.

entries.name: Tree branch
entries.description: Branch or limb on the road.

entries.name: Broken glass
entries.description: Glass fragments that can puncture tyres.

entries.name: Metal scrap
entries.description: Sharp metal debris.

entries.name: Tyre on road
entries.description: Tyre or tread fragment lying in a lane.

entries.name: Vehicle parts
entries.description: Bumpers, lamps or other parts after a collision or breakdown.

entries.name: Garbage
entries.description: Waste bags or dumped refuse on the carriageway.

entries.name: Cargo spillage
entries.description: Load fallen or spilled from a vehicle.

entries.name: Animal carcass
entries.description: Dead animal on the road.

entries.name: Fallen electric pole
entries.description: Fallen utility pole, possibly with live wires.

entries.name: Displaced road furniture
entries.description: Delineators, bollards or barriers knocked into the lane.
